posts.title: Codifying a Bash Style Guide as ShellCheck Plugins
posts.description: A style guide is just text. An enforced check is a tool that catches mistakes.

posts.title: Adding a Plugin System to ShellCheck
posts.description: I wanted shellcheck to catch a class of mistakes it wasn’t designed to catch — conventions specific to my bash style. Naming rules. Quoting under IFS=$'\n'; set -o noglob. Docstring shape. Things upstream would (rightly) never accept as core checks, because they’re house rules, not bash mistakes.

posts.title: Cockburn Use Cases Guide
posts.description: A practical reference for writing use cases per Alistair Cockburn’s Writing Effective Use Cases (2001). Template, goal levels, and step-writing guidelines distilled for software teams that want to capture behavior without designing the UI.
